thread:
Maya: quick heads-up — p95 for /v1/generate jumped ~200ms after shifting 10% to quantized fallback. p50 unchanged, p99 up more. sample-count looks steady. artifact?

Devin: likely merge artifact. endpoint-level rollups drop variant tags so tdigest merges can move percentiles non-linearly when route weights shift.

Sanjay: seen this. quantized path samples differently. without provenance the merged quantile is misleading.

Maya: console logs show variant=quantized for those requests but widget is endpoint-only.

Jorge: UX idea: add a small provenance pill on p50/p95/p99 showing "merged (n=12k)" and expand to per-variant counts.

Devin: backend: attach compact counts map to rollup proto (e.g., sample_counts_by_variant) so UI can display splits without high-card series. I'll own proto PR.

Lee: Ops note — keep it compact to avoid cardinality/storage spikes. provenance map seems acceptable; full per-variant rollups opt-in.

ops-bot: feature-flag: telemetry-provenance queued for staging deploy.

Maya: action items: Devin proto+PR, Lee cost check, Jorge mock pill+tooltip, Sanjay doc blurb. I'll follow up with example screenshot.
